answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one quartz weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 224 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 204 times the capital for one share. The signal report makes public the merge explicitly at each ivory. A farm of 1655 identities would post 3979 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
